title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Third edition, Volume 14, PAS-PLA - EB.6
text: The water of kali of the preferdition of the Lou- don phamaspects, then, may be considered an an improvement of the lixivium tartari of their former edition. But the Edibungu colleges, considering this foi- skinism being to no verifyet different from the ane ley pure water, have entirely rejected this preparation from their phamaspects, and probably with julitice.
